news.headline: The Man Who Helped the C.I.A. Secretly Operate in Mexico
news.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum drew a firm line barring U.S. forces from operating on Mexican soil. But in a northern border state, one local partner quietly helped the agency build a foothold.

news.headline: In Argentina, Pope Leo Walks in the Giant Shadow of Francis
news.summary: Francis never returned to his home country after becoming pope, but the new pontiff will still be confronted with the overwhelming presence of his predecessor.
